assessment.summary: This study performed genome-wide sequencing and association analyses on 969 female Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles coluzzii collected as larvae in 2017 across six West African sites in Benin, Côte d'Ivoire, Ghana, and Togo. Mosquitoes were phenotyped for susceptibility/resistance to deltamethrin and pirimiphos-methyl using WHO tube bioassays. Allele frequencies and CNVs were quantified across sites for target markers including Vgsc L995F, Vgsc V402L/I1527T, Vgsc N1570Y, Ace-1 G280S, Ace-1 CNV, Rdl A296G/S, and Cyp4j5 L43F.
